entradas.text: "We must rally the people against the Supreme Court. That would put pressure on their investigation."
entradas.menu: "We must rally the people against the Supreme Court. That would put pressure on their investigation."

entradas.text: "The public opinion is concerning. We must focus on campaigning for the next election already."
entradas.menu: "The public opinion is concerning. We must focus on campaigning for the next election already."

entradas.text: "We must focus on raising our public opinion and start campaigning for the next election already."
entradas.menu: "We must focus on raising our public opinion and start campaigning for the next election already."

entradas.text: "The state of our economy is very concerning. It must be our focus to achieve quick economic development."
entradas.menu: "The state of our economy is very concerning. It must be our focus to achieve quick economic development."

entradas.text: "Economy will be our number one priority until the end of our term. We will aim to boost it further."
entradas.menu: "Economy will be our number one priority until the end of our term. We will aim to boost it further."

entradas.text: "It's time to focus on changing our party as a whole. I will add a new vision in our manifesto."
entradas.menu: "It's time to focus on changing our party as a whole. I will add a new vision in our manifesto."

entradas.text: The cabinet looked uneasy. Lileas spoke with a concerned look in her eyes.
Lucian nodded in agreement.
Symon nodded in agreement.
"I'm sorry?"
"Sordland needs to become an economic powerhouse."
entradas.menu: "Sordland needs to become an economic powerhouse."

entradas.text: "We can't get elected if we do not improve the economy."
entradas.menu: "We can't get elected if we do not improve the economy."

entradas.text: "We should focus on eliminating poverty and homelessness."
entradas.menu: "We should focus on eliminating poverty and homelessness."

entradas.text: "We must convince the public that the emergency was useful."
entradas.menu: "We must convince the public that the emergency was useful."

entradas.text: "We should put more focus on our constitutional victory."
entradas.menu: "We should put more focus on our constitutional victory."

entradas.text: "We should blame the opposition for the failure of the reforms."
entradas.menu: "We should blame the opposition for the failure of the reforms."

entradas.text: "We can't get elected if we do not convince the public in some way."
entradas.menu: "We can't get elected if we do not convince the public in some way."

entradas.text: There was a mixed response, but the majority seemed to be in agreement with me.
Almost everybody seemed to be in agreement with me.
"It's time USP shifts away from Sollism."
entradas.menu: "It's time USP shifts away from Sollism."

entradas.text: "As I said, I will reform our party platform."
entradas.menu: "As I said, I will reform our party platform."

entradas.text: "I see. And the party leadership will agree with that?"
"You see, I am the current chairman Mrs. Graf..."
entradas.menu: "You see, I am the current chairman Mrs. Graf..."

entradas.text: "Do you not agree with that, Mrs. Graf?"
entradas.menu: "Do you not agree with that, Mrs. Graf?"

entradas.text: "I just wanted to announce this earlier, so you are aware. I won't change my mind."
entradas.menu: "I just wanted to announce this earlier, so you are aware. I won't change my mind."

entradas.text: "If there are no comments, let's move on with the meeting."
entradas.menu: "If there are no comments, let's move on with the meeting."

entradas.text: "You'll learn about my thoughts if you bring your suggestions to the leadership."
"You are right about that. However, the party does not belong to you, Mr. President."
"That was the extent of my comments. We can move on."
"Thank you for your comments."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your comments."

entradas.text: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. It has already been decided."
entradas.menu: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. It has already been decided."

entradas.text: "If there are no comments, I want to talk about another plan."
entradas.menu: "If there are no comments, I want to talk about another plan."

entradas.text: "Now that we can, we will start an investigation on Tarquin Soll. It was long overdue."
entradas.menu: "Now that we can, we will start an investigation on Tarquin Soll. It was long overdue."

entradas.text: "We can finally impeach Justices. Let's organize the Assembly against the Chief Justice."
entradas.menu: "We can finally impeach Justices. Let's organize the Assembly against the Chief Justice."

entradas.text: "With the new laws, I can reshuffle the Supreme Court. I want a list of names."
entradas.menu: "With the new laws, I can reshuffle the Supreme Court. I want a list of names."

entradas.text: "On a second thought, let's just move on with the meeting before it gets too late."
entradas.menu: "On a second thought, let's just move on with the meeting before it gets too late."

entradas.text: "Yes, sir. I agree."
"Yes, sir. I'll start working on it immediately."
Iosef narrowed his eyes and stared at me. I couldn't help but feel uncomfortable.
"I have no words. And nobody else is going to react?"
Lileas stood up and took a long look at the ministers around the table.
"I cannot believe this administration comes from the United Sordland Party."
"A lot of people suffered under Soll. Justice must be served."
entradas.menu: "A lot of people suffered under Soll. Justice must be served."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your comments but I have already decided."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your comments but I have already decided."

entradas.text: "I thought you respected Sollism. It seems I was completely wrong."
"He will not sit idly against your attacks, Mr. President."
"Let's just move on, Mrs. Graf."
entradas.menu: "Let's just move on, Mrs. Graf."

entradas.text: "He is an old man, Mrs. Graf. What is he going to do?"
entradas.menu: "He is an old man, Mrs. Graf. What is he going to do?"

entradas.text: She did not respond.
"I asked you something."
entradas.menu: "I asked you something."

entradas.text: "You are right, Mr. President. *As always*. Let's just move on."
"I'll start making the necessary arrangements."
"You've heard me."
entradas.menu: "You've heard me."

entradas.text: I turned to the others.
Lucian put on his glasses to inspect the documents in front of him.
He wrote on the document and put down his pen after.

Lucian put on his glasses to inspect the documents in front of him.
She sighed deeply. I looked at the cabinet to measure their reactions. No one said anything.
Then I looked at everyone else to measure their reactions. No one said anything.
I looked at her.
entradas.menu: Stay silent.
